name: App A4: the studio Player on the Motion engine (same PlayerHandle, audio, capture, selection)
description: Rebuilds web/src/player on the Motion engine: the composition goes through aepToMotion and plays on MotionRuntime, behind VITE_ENGINE (motion by default at the end). The PlayerHandle contract (canvas, play, pause, seek, time, whenReady) stays, audio cues play in sync, review capture and export keep working, and canvas selection gets layer bounds from the engine.

readFirst: web/src/capture/driver.ts (how review capture uses PlayerHandle) and web/src/selection/useCanvasSelect.ts, pixiTarget.ts
extraGuardrails: Keep the PlayerHandle method names and their meaning (seconds at the boundary). getApp() may return null on the motion engine; every caller must cope with null.
Keep the library path working behind VITE_ENGINE=library until A5; do not delete it here.
manualGates: MG-1: owner opens the studio on a stored film with VITE_ENGINE=motion, plays, seeks, and runs one review capture.

stories.title: MotionStage: convert, load and play one composition on MotionRuntime
stories.description: As a developer working on the studio, I want a component that takes an AepCompositionJson and plays it on the Motion engine so that the Player can switch to it.
steps: Read engine/docs/06-runtime-player.md (MotionRuntime and MotionPlayer API) and engine/src/runtime and engine/src/react.

Create web/src/motion/player/MotionStage.tsx: converts with aepToMotion (resolveUrl keeps /api/assets urls), mounts a MotionRuntime on a canvas sized like the current Player (longest side 960, doc resolution kept for capture), exposes play, pause, seek(sec), getTime, getCanvas, whenReady(timeoutSec) through a ref, and reports warnings through an onWarnings prop.
Create web/src/motion/player/MotionStage.test.tsx with the runtime replaced by a fake (vi.mock of the engine runtime module) checking the calls.
acceptance: Rendering MotionStage with a stored film's composition calls the runtime load with a doc whose width and height match the composition
ref.seek(2) calls the runtime seek with 2 and ref.getTime() returns the runtime's time
A composition that aepToMotion rejects shows an error message instead of throwing

stories.title: Audio cues in sync with the clock
stories.description: As a viewer, I want the film's music to play with the picture so that the new player sounds like the old one.
steps: Read engine/docs/10-aep-adapter.md (AudioCue) and the clock API of MotionRuntime.

Create web/src/motion/player/audio.ts exporting createAudioSync(cues, { createAudio }) with play(t), pause(), seek(t), dispose(): each cue gets an HTMLAudioElement (injectable for tests), volume = level, playing only while startSec <= t < endSec at currentTime = t - startSec; resync when drift exceeds 0.15 s.
Use it from MotionStage (play/pause/seek follow the runtime).
Create web/src/motion/player/audio.test.ts with fake audio elements.
acceptance: seek(5) on a cue 0..24 s sets currentTime 5; play(5) calls play() once; pause() pauses every element
A cue 10..20 s is paused at t 5 and plays from currentTime 2 at t 12
dispose() pauses and releases every element

stories.title: Player.tsx switches engines with VITE_ENGINE and keeps PlayerHandle
stories.description: As a panel that holds a PlayerHandle, I want the same handle from the new engine so that chat, review, export and the crew UI keep working.
steps: Read web/src/player/Player.tsx, PlayerBridge.tsx and Player.test.tsx.

Add VITE_ENGINE ('motion' | 'library', default 'library' in this story) to web/src/vite-env.d.ts and web/.env.example; in Player.tsx render MotionStage plus the existing Controls (rewired to the MotionStage ref) when it is 'motion', and the library path otherwise.
The motion handle implements getCanvas, getApp (returns null), play, pause, seek, getTime and whenReady.
Extend Player.test.tsx with a motion case (MotionStage mocked) checking the handle methods.
acceptance: With VITE_ENGINE=motion the Player renders MotionStage and its handle's seek(3) reaches MotionStage's seek with 3
With VITE_ENGINE=library the existing Player tests pass unchanged
Controls' play/pause and slider drive the motion handle

stories.title: Review capture and export work with a null getApp
stories.description: As a developer working on the review loop, I want frame capture to work on the new engine so that the critic still sees frames.
steps: Read web/src/capture/driver.ts (uses player.getApp() for Pixi extract) and capture.test.ts.
When getApp() is null, capture from player.getCanvas() after seek and whenReady (the engine renders with preserveDrawingBuffer), using canvas.toBlob; keep the Pixi path for the library engine.
Add a capture.test.ts case with a fake handle whose getApp returns null.
acceptance: captureScene with a handle whose getApp() is null seeks each time, waits for whenReady and returns one blob per time from the canvas

stories.title: Canvas selection on the motion engine
stories.description: As a user editing by clicking the canvas, I want a click to select the layer under the pointer on the new engine so that chat edits keep their target.
steps: Read web/src/selection/useCanvasSelect.ts, pixiTarget.ts, SelectionOverlay.tsx and the engine's node list (runtime nodes, each with display and size).

Create web/src/selection/motionTarget.ts exporting hitTest(nodes, x, y, time) returning the front-most visible node id whose display bounds (Box3 of the display projected to stage pixels) contain the point, and boundsOf(node) for the overlay; expose the runtime nodes from MotionStage through the handle (optional getNodes()).
Use it in useCanvasSelect when the handle has getNodes; keep pixiTarget for the library engine.
Create web/src/selection/motionTarget.test.ts with plain THREE objects.
acceptance: Two overlapping 100x100 nodes: a click inside both returns the front one; a click outside both returns null
A hidden node (display.visible false) is never hit

stories.title: Default to the motion engine; browser check of the studio
stories.description: As a project owner, I want the studio to use the new engine by default so that the demo runs on Three.js.
steps: Read web/src/vite-env.d.ts and web/.env.example.
Make 'motion' the default when VITE_ENGINE is unset.

Open http://localhost:5173/ on a stored film (gallery → film) with headless Chromium, play two seconds, seek to the middle, save screenshots to debug/app/ and record console errors (none expected) in notes.
acceptance: With no VITE_ENGINE set the Player mounts MotionStage (test)
The studio screenshot shows the film's frame drawn by the motion engine and the console has no errors
notes names the film id and the screenshots
